scenario: [LNLS.3.7] / [LSTR.11.4]: a regex match whose left operand is a `String` slot that declares `capacity N` compiles with `linear_scan: false` -- the match costs O(N x P) with both compile-time constants. Companion to `LNLS.3.7.json`, the same program without the capacity, which is refused with `DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_UNBOUNDED_REGEX`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.unbounded_string`'s `lstr_11_4_declares_capacity` arm, reached from `lnls_expr`'s `ex_match` arm. A validator that ignored the slot's capacity refuses this and the vector goes red.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Line scope logical:
    k: Int key
    text: String capacity 64 mutable

rule r:
    Line l where l.text ~ /^ERR/
->
    log info "x"
